description: Fixed signer-disjoint split of MINDS-Libras (Brazilian Sign Language, isolated glosses) for cross-lingual transfer evaluation (P1, 6th target language, replacing INCLUDE-50). 20 signs, 12 signers; train=signers 1-8, val=9-10, test=11-12. Signer id is the top-level Sinalizador<SS> directory (Zenodo record 2667329, one zip per signer).
